citation.authors: Kim TK, Oh J, Ha YS, Son HJ et al

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: Korean adults aged 19 to 60 with mild to moderate hair damage and no alopecia (number not given in the abstract)
record.design: Randomised double-blind placebo-controlled trial, 3 g/day low-molecular-weight collagen peptide for 24 weeks
record.finding: Compared with placebo, hair gloss, elasticity (tensile strength) and diameter improved, and scalp elasticity rose. No treatment-related adverse events.
record.note: Hair damage, not hair loss or growth. One branded peptide. Hair type and funding not in the abstract.
